title: Warlock (Complete Arcane, D&D 3.5)
secondarySourceCaution: Third-party websites may label their pages SRD, but the Complete Arcane Warlock is not part of the original 3.5e core SRD. Index material is used to corroborate mechanical facts; consult an authorized copy for final textual verification.
rightsAndScope: Independently prepared historical mechanical research notes and provenance only; no reproduction of copyrighted class text or book pages. This entry is not a license to redistribute Complete Arcane.

chassis.note: These historical values are evidence, not automatic native selections.

historicalInvocationSystem.legacyUseConditions: Invocations were not ordinary spell slots; timing, interruption and resistance operated as spell-like abilities.
historicalInvocationSystem.comparisonNote: 2014 supports up to 8 invocations known; 2024 supports up to 10. Do not combine separate invocation progressions automatically.

historicalEldritchBlast.note: Eldritch Blast is a spell-like INVOCATION per official 2005 Complete Arcane errata; it is granted automatically, not chosen from limited invocation-known slots. It is not automatically additive to the modern scalable cantrip's multiple beams.

historicalClassFeatures.name: Deceive Item
historicalClassFeatures.mechanicSummary: More reliable use of magic items through the historical Use Magic Device skill.

historicalClassFeatures.name: Fiendish Resilience
historicalClassFeatures.mechanicSummary: Limited-use brief self-healing, improving at levels 13 and 18.

historicalClassFeatures.name: Energy Resistance
historicalClassFeatures.mechanicSummary: Choose two historical energy types for resistance; increases at 20.

historicalClassFeatures.name: Imbue Item
historicalClassFeatures.mechanicSummary: With relevant item-creation prerequisite, substitute a historical item-use skill check for missing spells used in crafting.
